title: Pushp Brand (India) IPO
summary: Pushp Brand (India) IPO is a book-built issue of 74.45 lakh shares, proposed to be listed on BSE and NSE. The IPO dates, price band and lot size are yet to be announced.

b.p: Pushp Brand (India) IPO has a total issue size of 74,45,000 shares and will be listed on BSE, NSE. Price band & Lot size details are yet to be announced.

kv: ICICI Securities Ltd.,, IIFL Capital Services Ltd.,, Systematix Corporate Services Ltd.

b.p: Data sourced from DRHP / RHP • For educational purposes only
Pushp Brand (India) financials show revenue growth and profitability trends over recent years, indicating business stability.

Incorporated in 1974, Pushp Brand (India) Limited is involved in the production and selling of packaged spices and food products under the brand names of ‘Pushp’ and ‘Munimji’. The company produces pure spices, blended spices, hing, soya products, and tea in various price segments and pack sizes. · · The company has a strong presence in West and Central India with its products available in 24 states and union territories via general trade, modern trade, e-commerce, quick-commerce, and HoReCa channels. The company has a total of 1,016 distributors and over 368,000 retail touchpoints in India. · · The company has two automated and ISO-certified manufacturing units located at Indore, Madhya Pradesh, with an annual production capacity of 60,000 MT.The company is one of the major brands of spices in Madhya Pradesh with around 20.7% market share in packaged spices and approximately 58% market share in the packaged hing category in the state. · · As of March 31, 2026, the company had 312 SKUs and 1,152 employees.
Mahendra Kumar Surana, Surendra Kumar Surana are the company's promoters of Pushp Brand (India).

ul: The Pushp Brand (India) Limited IPO is a 100% Offer for Sale (OFS)
